title: HateMirage: An Explainable Multi-Dimensional Dataset for Decoding Faux Hate and Subtle Online Abuse
reasoning: The paper benchmarks Large Language Models on the HateMirage dataset, which specifically focuses on 'Faux Hate' targeting religious groups. The evaluation includes dimensions of 'Intent' and 'Implication,' which require models to reason about the moral motivations and social-ethical consequences of harmful narratives.
